subject: Consensus playbook & champion bootcamp — next steps / procurement gate
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: consensus playbook & champion bootcamp — next steps / procurement gate

Claire — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and recommended next steps from our side so we keep momentum toward a pilot: 

1) Quick recap (agreed on call)
- Use case: customer support summarization + actionable routing for large enterprise accounts.
- Pilot scope: 10 agents, 30k monthly messages, 6-week pilot.
- Success criteria: 40% reduction in average handle time (AHT) and >90% accuracy on intent extraction compared to current baseline.

2) Decision roles we heard
- Champion: Claire Zhao (product) — internal evangelist and technical liaison
- Economic buyer: Rajiv Menon (CFO) — budget sign-off and unit-economics scrutiny
- Security/legal gate: FinPath procurement + security review (SOC 2 + data flow diagram required)

3) Proposed next steps (my ask to Claire / your champion playbook)
- Champion bootcamp: 30–45 minute internal prep session we run for Claire and 2–3 stakeholders (talk tracks + ROI one-pager).
- Mutual action plan (attached): we populate procurement checklist and target dates.
- Security packet: we will send SOC2 report, data residency notes, and an architecture diagram by EOD tomorrow.

4) Logistics / timeline
- Target procurement kickoff: week of Jun 14 (Claire to loop procurement)
- Pilot start: week of Jul 5, pending procurement & legal sign-off

Attachment: FinPath_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (skeleton MAP with dates).

Notes on talk tracks for champion (short bullets you can reuse):
- Cost angle: expected inference cost drop ~2.1x vs current API by using Redwood Optimize + batching.
- Time-to-value: pilot shows production-ready results in 6 weeks with our Dedicated runtime.
- Risk mitigation: automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for latency spikes; full audit trail in Console.

I'll schedule a 30-minute "Champion bootcamp" slot — propose Thu 6/10 10:00am PT. Let me know if that works and who from finance/security you want on the call.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
